A crate factory is a place where you can pack [[crates]] of various [[items]] to be sold on the [[Trade Office|market]]. You can build it only on a single spot between the [[workyard]] and the [[kitchen garden]] (which means it has access to storages from both!), using the workbench in the workyard.

The factory works similar to the [[packing table]] but has additional options for some kind of [[items|goods]]. It comes complete with a built-in elevator, [[pallet]]s and a [[porter station]] in the [[cellar]].

You can put two [[zombie]]s at work to pack and transport your goods. This is how it looks when a [[zombie]] works outside at the station packaging your goods:

[[file:crate factory outside.png|300px|Zombie at crate factory outside]]

As soon as a [[crates|crate]] is ready it's put on the elevator to the [[cellar]] where it's moved instantly from the output chute onto a [[crate pallet]]. From there, it can be picked up manually or by a second [[zombie]] worker to be transported to the [[trade office]].

This is how it looks down in the [[barn cellar]]. Not all of the [[pallet]]s are shown, there's a total of twelve available. The picture shows no [[zombie]] assigned to the [[porter station]], so it's necessary to transport the [[crates]] by human labor:

[[file:crate factory inside.png|300px|Crate factory output in the cellar]]
